mapper.select:
/* SmsUserStatusMapper.getSmsUserList */ SELECT twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, tcsr.USER_ID, twuidv01.USER_NM, tcsr.DI AS DI, SBPENC.D(tcsr.TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(tcsr.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST tcsr, TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 AND twuidv01.USER_ID (+) = tcsr.USER_ID
AND twuidv01.ORGN_CD LIKE '%' || #{orgnCd} || '%'
AND twuidv01.ORGN_NM LIKE '%' || #{orgnNm} || '%'
AND tcsr.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND twuidv01.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{userNm} || '%'
ORDER BY tcsr.REG_DT DESC

/* SmsUserStatusMapper.getSendTelNoList */ SELECT hst.OGN_CD AS ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, SBPENC.D(hst.TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, hst.USE_YN, hst.CERT_ID, tcasn.USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = tcasn.USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS USER_NM FROM HCS_SENDM_T hst, TB_CM_ADD_SMS_NO tcasn, ( SELECT twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD, ( CASE WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'H' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_HQ_OFFICE WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD) WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'S' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_MS_STORE WHERE STORE_CD = twuidv01.STORE_CD) ELSE null END ) AS AGENCY_CD FROM ( SELECT DECODE(twuidv01.ORGN_FG, 'A', 'M', twuidv01.ORGN_FG) AS ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 twuidv01 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1
AND twuidv01.ORGN_CD LIKE '%'||#{orgnCd}||'%'
AND twuidv01.ORGN_NM LIKE '%'||#{orgnNm}||'%'
AND tcasn.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = tcasn.USER_ID AND USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{userNm} || '%')
AND tcasn.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
AND tcasn.USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
AND twuidv01.ORGN_CD = hst.OGN_CD AND tcasn.ORGN_CD (+) = hst.OGN_CD AND tcasn.TEL_NO (+) = hst.TEL_NO AND tcasn.CERT_ID (+) = hst.CERT_ID ORDER BY hst.OGN_CD, hst.USE_SEQ

/* SmsUserStatusMapper.getSmsChargeStatusList */ SELECT cpt.OGN_CD AS ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, ('[' || cpt.OGN_CD || '] ' || twuidv01.ORGN_NM || ' (현재잔여금액 : ' || cst.SMS_AMT || ')') AS ORGN, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(cpt.CHARGE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CHARGE_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(cpt.CHARGE_TIME, 'HH24MISS'), 'HH24:MI:SS') AS CHARGE_TIME, cpt.PGRESOURCE, cpt.CONTROLNO, cpt.APPROVALNUM, NVL(cpt.BASE_CHARGE_AMT, 0) AS BASE_CHARGE_AMT, NVL(cpt.CHARGE_AMT, 0) AS CHARGE_AMT, NVL(cpt.CHARGE_TOT - cpt.CHARGE_AMT, 0) AS VAT_AMT, NVL(cpt.CHARGE_TOT, 0) AS CHARGE_TOT, cpt.SUCCESS_YN, cpt.CHARGE_ID, (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = cpt.CHARGE_ID) AS CHARGE_ID_NM, cpt.RESULTMESSAGE FROM CET_PGLOG_T cpt, CET_SMSPT_T cst, ( SELECT twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD, ( CASE WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'H' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_HQ_OFFICE WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD) WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'S' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_MS_STORE WHERE STORE_CD = twuidv01.STORE_CD) ELSE twuidv01.ORGN_CD END ) AS AGENCY_CD FROM ( SELECT DECODE(twuidv01.ORGN_FG, 'A', 'M', twuidv01.ORGN_FG) AS ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 twuidv01 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 AND cpt.CHARGE_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND cpt.OGN_CD LIKE '%'||#{orgnCd}||'%'
AND twuidv01.ORGN_NM LIKE '%'||#{orgnNm}||'%'
AND cpt.CHARGE_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = cpt.CHARGE_ID AND USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{userNm} || '%')
AND cpt.CHARGE_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
AND cpt.CHARGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
AND cst.OGN_CD (+)= cpt.OGN_CD AND twuidv01.ORGN_CD = cst.OGN_CD ORDER BY cpt.OGN_CD ASC, cpt.CHARGE_DATE DESC, cpt.CHARGE_TIME DESC

/* SmsUserStatusMapper.getSmsSendHistList */ SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT hssrt.REG_DT, hssrt.SMS_SEND_ORGN_CD, (SELECT ORGN_NM FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE ORGN_CD = hssrt.SMS_SEND_ORGN_CD GROUP BY ORGN_NM) AS SMS_SEND_ORGN_NM, hssrt.SMS_SEND_SEQ, hssrt.SMS_SEND_COUNT, hssrt.MSG_TYPE, hssrt.SUBJECT, hssrt.MSG_CONTENT, DECODE(hssrt.RESERVE_YN, '1', TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(hssrt.SEND_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), NULL) AS SEND_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(hssrt.READ_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS READ_DATE, hssrt.RESERVE_YN, hssrt.SEND_QTY, hssrt.WAIT_QTY, hssrt.SUCCESS_QTY, hssrt.FAIL_QTY, hssrt.S_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NM FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 WHERE USER_ID = hssrt.S_USER_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS S_USER_NM FROM HCS_SMS_SEND_REG_T hssrt, ( SELECT twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD, (CASE WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'H' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_HQ_OFFICE WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD) WHEN twuidv01.ORGN_FG = 'S' THEN (SELECT AGENCY_CD FROM TB_MS_STORE WHERE STORE_CD = twuidv01.STORE_CD) ELSE twuidv01.ORGN_CD END ) AS AGENCY_CD FROM ( SELECT DECODE(twuidv01.ORGN_FG, 'A', 'M', twuidv01.ORGN_FG) AS ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD FROM TB_WB_USER_INFO_DTL_V01 twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY twuidv01.ORGN_FG, twuidv01.ORGN_CD, twuidv01.ORGN_NM, twuidv01.HQ_OFFICE_CD, twuidv01.STORE_CD ) twuidv01 WHERE 1=1 AND hssrt.REG_DT BETWEEN #{startDate}||'000000' AND #{endDate}||'235959' AND twuidv01.ORGN_CD = hssrt.SMS_SEND_ORGN_CD ORDER BY hssrt.REG_DT DESC ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.SMS_SEND_ORGN_CD LIKE '%' || #{orgnCd} || '%'
AND A.SMS_SEND_ORGN_NM LIKE '%' || #{orgnNm} || '%'
AND A.S_USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{userId} || '%'
AND A.S_USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{userNm} || '%'
AND A.S_USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
AND A.S_USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_CM_SMS_USER_REGIST)
